parent_objective: run a no-training promoted-base source-rich public smoke through the capability-step cross-fault harness
blocked_by: M1372 admits a no-training source-rich smoke before larger source-rich waves or L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison refresh
supersedes: using source-rich configs without claim-boundary audit
using private holdout for source-rich debugging
routing directly from public-base promotion to PPO continuation

public_gates: M1373 must run the promoted M1362 base through the public capability-step cross-fault harness
M1373 must keep actor inputs and checkpoint parameters unchanged
M1373 must produce summary, scenario, pair, intervention, accepted, reset-only, rejected, and model-fidelity artifacts
M1373 must keep private holdout unused
M1373 must treat accepted-row sparsity as source-sampling evidence rather than a threshold-relaxation trigger
forbidden_shortcuts: do not mutate the candidate checkpoint
do not claim true single-wheel, split-mu, halfshaft, or suspension physics from proxy configs
do not claim paper-level evidence or level3 self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the first no-training source-rich public smoke for the promoted M1362 base
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public source-rich smoke only; no promotion, private holdout, PPO, high-fidelity, L0/L1/L2/L3, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source-rich artifacts are missing or malformed
stop if checkpoint or actor parameters change
stop if private holdout is used
stop if proxy faults are interpreted as true high-fidelity per-wheel physics
fallback_plan: if harness runs cleanly, route to source-rich result audit or larger public source-rich wave design
if harness artifacts are incomplete, route to evaluator/tooling repair
if no accepted rows are found, classify as source sampling evidence and decide whether reset/temporal variants or larger public wave are needed
if claim boundary is violated, route to claim-boundary audit before more experiments
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1372 admitted source-rich smoke as the next public evidence increment

admission_evidence: M1370 promotes M1362 alpha 0.1 as the public-gate base
M1372 defines source-rich claim boundaries and smoke pass conditions
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: scenario, snapshot, and matched-pair counts are positive
checkpoint and actor contract are unchanged
source-rich metrics are interpreted without high-fidelity overclaiming

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1373 can expose reset or wrong-history sensitivity but cannot by itself prove level3 anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: normal, wrong-history, and reset-history source-rich interventions are recorded by the existing harness
accepted wrong-history rows and reset-only rows are interpreted separately
zero accepted wrong-history rows must be recorded as negative or sparse source-sampling evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362 promoted public base under M990 capability-step cross-fault public smoke.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If accepted rows are sparse or zero, record the negative result and route to audit, temporal variants, or larger public source-rich wave instead of relaxing thresholds.
allowed_claims: source-rich public smoke artifact and metric result
no promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level, L0/L1/L2/L3, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The promoted M1362 public-gate base can be evaluated through the public capability-step cross-fault harness without actor mutation, private holdout, or proxy-physics overclaiming.
success_criteria: scenario and pair CSV artifacts are readable
failure_criteria: summary or core CSV artifacts are missing
scenario_count, snapshot_count, or matched_pair_count is zero
actor parameters or actor inputs change
training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout occurs
future-only high-fidelity faults are reported as executed physical claims

commands.name: source_rich_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.extreme_dynamics_scenario_corpus --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m990_capability_step_fault_scenarios.json --pairing-mode cross_fault --seed-start 137300 --seed-count 64 --device auto --run-dir runs/m1373_promoted_base_source_rich_smoke

decision_rule: M1373 passes as source-rich public smoke if it produces clean no-training cross-fault artifacts with unchanged actor/checkpoint contract and no private-holdout or high-fidelity overclaim.
